lesson.introText:
Hey guys! I’m BUDDY! Today, we’ll remove a vowel that survives in almost every advanced speaker. It’s the... …GHOST E! It hides in the longest words you use: strategy

The longer the word, the less you hear yourself add the extra vowel. Three-consonant clusters (str-, spr-, scr-) are where it always comes back.
